ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Jupiter

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1808065310000}, the Moon moves into {S:6} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Mercury and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.
